purpose: Test code-native physical scenes and Gaussian representations under separately controlled views and illumination.

source_fixture.adapter_note: Fixture K uses integer-centre pixels. Verify destination rasterizer conventions, including any +0.5 principal-point shift. Matrix direction and normal/depth conversions are explicit in metadata.

relighting_development.warm_left_use: Validation only; do not fit model parameters to validation RGB. Model selection may use it and must be recorded.
relighting_development.physical_material_parameters: Known declared procedural parameters may be supplied to the proposed physically supervised branch; this is a stronger supervision setting than RGB-only reconstruction and must be labelled.
relighting_development.illumination_at_test: The declared test light parameters are inputs; test rendered RGB is evaluation-only.
relighting_development.scope: Three finite-distance area lights define a narrow explicit-light editing test, not arbitrary-light generalization or a far-field PRT benchmark.
relighting_development.not_applicable_to_E5b_without_new_fixtur: Low-frequency environment-light PRT needs a separately generated basis and unseen-light-combination protocol; those data are not present.

frozen_evaluation_protocol.missing_pixels: Do not silently remove failing regions or NaNs; record masks and failures.
metrics: per-view PSNR in a fixed declared display domain
frozen_evaluation_protocol.reference_rule: The old renderer is a baseline, not certified ground truth. Validate physical cases against independent analytical or renderer references.
